findings.message: If a `max_iterations` cycle entry in the state file is missing `iterations_used` or `max_iterations` fields, `_convergence_json` carries JSON `null` for those values and the rendered convergence line shows `(null/null iterations)` instead of real counts, giving the operator no usable information.

The `_extra` block (convergence warning and failing-gate lines) is appended after `"Generated by zBuild automation."`, so the safety-critical operator notice appears below the footer rather than in a prominent position; acceptance criteria check for string presence, not position, so tests pass, but the warning is easy to overlook.

When `state.status` is `"failed"` (SPEC-1) but no cycle has `status == "max_iterations"` (SPEC-2 does not apply), `_convergence_json` remains `[]` and `_pr_open_render_convergence_section` emits nothing; SPEC-3 says the body must include a convergence section when SPEC-1 applies, so a failed-but-converged run produces a draft PR with no convergence text, leaving the operator with only the gate section (if present) as context.
